subject: Quick thought on the Barley Swine website
body: Hi team at Barley Swine, I recently came across your Austin-based spot while looking for places with a truly curated wine selection and expert knowledge. I love what you do for local wine enthusiasts and casual patrons alike. While browsing your current site, I noticed it could use a few quick updates to help local guests connect with you faster—specifically adding clear operating hours, your physical address, and a direct contact phone number right on the page. Since I build modern websites, I went ahead and put together a live warm-editorial prototype for you to see how those details and a streamlined layout can look in action. You can check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644b4df2ef2dd89-0x47d117aa79f293f-iyfbksjwj.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for five minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added direct contact phone number and physical address
Improved visual layout and interactive elements
